name: optcatalog_register_damage_mask_slot_ptr
description: OptCatalog::RegisterDamageMaskSlotPtr enables damage-mask rendering and stores the supplied slot pointer at the current damage-mask slot index.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the zModel/OptCatalog damage-mask provider pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x479c60 validates setting g_OptCatalogDamageMaskEnabled to 1 and writing the supplied slot pointer into g_OptCatalogDamageMaskHandles[g_OptCatalogDamageMaskSlotIndex].
The native smoke verifies the enabled flag and indexed slot write through SetDamageMaskSlotIndex followed by RegisterDamageMaskSlotPtr.
